description.raw:
'''Innate:''' Whenever a nearby enemy champion dies, '''Lissandra''' spawns a ''Frozen Thrall'' from their corpse.

''Frozen Thralls'' are ice spirits that have 33.48 – 325 (based on seconds alive) movement speed and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slow]] nearby enemies by 25%. They will chase nearby [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] enemies for 4 seconds, prioritizing [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]], after which they shatter to deal 120 – 520 (based on level) (+ 50% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.
description.text:
Innate: Whenever a nearby enemy champion dies, Lissandra spawns a Frozen Thrall from their corpse.
Frozen Thralls are ice spirits that have 33.48 – 325 (based on seconds alive) movement speed and slow nearby enemies by 25%. They will chase nearby visible enemies for 4 seconds, prioritizing champions, after which they shatter to deal 120 – 520 (based on level) (+ 50% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.

notes.raw: * ''Thralls'' are units that are considered champions (they are [[File:Shaco Hallucinate 2.png|20px|link=Champion_summoned_units#decoys|An icon representing the keyword Clone]] [[:Champion_summoned_units#decoys|clones]]) and they take the form of the champion they arise from. ** Additionally, near the end of their life span, they will cue that champion's [[basic attack]] animation. ** They cannot be teleported by an allied [[File:Ryze Realm Warp.png|20xpx|border|link=Ryze#Realm Warp|An icon for Ryze's ability Realm Warp]] [[Ryze#Realm Warp|Realm Warp]]. * ''Thralls'' are [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] and [[File:Cosmic Radiance.png|20px|link=Invulnerability|An icon representing the keyword Invulnerability]] [[:Invulnerability|invulnerable]]. * ''Thralls'' are revealed to enemies through the fog of war. * ''Thralls'' will continue to chase their target even if they enter a [[File:Brushmaker.png|20px|link=Brush|An icon representing the keyword Brush]] [[:Brush|brush]]. * ''Iceborn Subjugation'' will not summon a ''Thrall'' against enemy champions that enter a [[File:Zombie icon.png|20px|link=Death#Zombie_states|An icon representing the keyword Zombie state]] [[:Death#Zombie_states|zombie state]], and will instead summon one after they've left the state.
notes.text:
Thralls are units that are considered champions (they are clones) and they take the form of the champion they arise from.
* Additionally, near the end of their life span, they will cue that champion's basic attack animation.
* They cannot be teleported by an allied Realm Warp.
Thralls are untargetable and invulnerable.
Thralls are revealed to enemies through the fog of war.
Thralls will continue to chase their target even if they enter a brush.
Iceborn Subjugation will not summon a Thrall against enemy champions that enter a zombie state, and will instead summon one after they've left the state.
